{{Quote|Science. Technology. The Force. Life. All can be turned to our purpose.|Dread Master Brontes|<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dread Master Brontes}}</ref>}}
'''Brontes''', also known as the '''"Architect of Fear"''', was a powerful [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith sorcerer|Sith sorceress]] and member of the [[Dread Masters]]. She lived throughout much of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] history, with her insights into the nature and purposes of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] leading the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to order an expansion of a nearby Sith tomb into the [[Dark Temple]]<ref name="Codex" /> not long after the Empire's arrival on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in [[4980 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Brontes [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielded]] no [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], but instead utilized her absolute [[Sith sorcery/Legends|mastery]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force's]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] to dispatch her foes. By her orders, Dread Forces on Oricon were modified with technological enhancements and weapons. She, along with the huge beast [[Grob'thok]] and [[Corruptor Zero]]'s robotic army were all brought down by Republic and Imperial strike teams during Dread Fortress operation raid.
